payload.title: Calls/WebRTC server (Rust port of FR-15)
payload.description: Port the realtime calls control plane to Rust: signaling routes + call-session store + SFU adapter + E2EE key exchange (TS FR-15 epic, now done in TS only — calls/* deleted at cutover). Large; the Swift/Kotlin/web call clients already exist. Carry over FR-204/207/210/211 calls/native audit fixes.
